Figure 1: Main interface of the experimental system. The interface consists of three main panels. (a) Agent Profile Panel: Displays information about the conversational chatbot. (b) Conversation Panel: Shows the explanation dialogue between agents and the user. (c) Movie Recommendation Panel: The list of twelve recommended movies (6 in-profile, 6 off-profile), where users can view agent endorsements, access IMDb pages, add titles to their watchlist, and rate movies.
